contract.scope: Pure in-memory conversation bookkeeping, no production callers or new service activation.
contract.clock: Caller supplies monotonic now to expire; complete/register do not consult a clock. Future owner must expire before deadline-dependent completion and independently enforce admission/currentness.
contract.correlation: Exact principal/epoch/correlation key; remembered reuse refuses, tombstone wrap forgets and caller non-reuse remains required.
contract.bounds: Logical pending/ring entry-count bounds, not fallible funded allocation/RSS/transient-vector accounting or authoritative quota credit.
contract.outcomes: Timeout/cancel advisory; epoch drop resolves pending state but does not revoke authority or prohibit later admission.
contract.authority: No reply authentication, durable receipts, guest envelope, new wire refusal, quota ledger, audit schema or process/epoch custody introduced.
contract.adr: D1-D6 Proposed; D7 settled MVMD/Iroh mailbox peer transport ownership; separately admitted host FlowMux authority remains distinct.
